dataset_metadata.name: Banking Regulation Benchmark Dataset
dataset_metadata.description: Gold-standard labelled query dataset for evaluating RAG retrieval recall, precision, and edge-case failures on the banking regulation corpus.

queries.query: How are suspicious transactions and beneficiary country risk scores monitored under AML directives?
queries.description: Validates that AML compliance and risk monitoring queries rank Section 1 chunk at rank #1.

queries.query: What minimum Tier 1 capital adequacy ratio is required under Basel IV?
queries.description: Validates that Basel IV capital adequacy queries rank Section 2 chunk at rank #1.

queries.query: What are the rules and approval thresholds for high-value transaction payments?
queries.description: Validates that payment threshold queries rank Section 3 authorization chunks in top results.

queries.query: Which vendor disbursements do NOT require unanimous board approval?
queries.description: Tests vector embedding blindspot with logical negation ('NOT'). Expected chunk specifies disbursements under $50k approved directly.

queries.query: What audit procedures and compliance checks are required for transaction authorization?
queries.description: Tests cross-section keyword distraction where words 'compliance' and 'audit' appear in both Section 1 and Section 3.

queries.query: How often must institutions calculate and submit the Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR)?
queries.description: Tests retrieval precision for exact acronym (LCR) and 30-day stress period reporting requirements.

queries.query: What consequences follow a failure to obtain board authorization for high-value expenditures?
queries.description: Tests retrieval for penalty clause (suspension of procurement privileges) located in trailing chunk.

queries.query: What automated screening protocols verify transaction velocity and entity sanction status?
queries.description: Validates semantic understanding when exact keywords are paraphrased ('automated screening protocols' vs 'automated compliance monitoring systems').
